head_height.value: 29-34mm from crown to chin (passport-type photo standards apply)

expression_restriction.value: Natural expression, no smiling, grinning or frowning; eyes open, mouth closed

glasses_policy.value: Remove glasses if possible; if worn, eyes must be clearly visible with no glare or reflections. Sunglasses or tinted glasses not allowed

face_visibility.value: Face forward, look straight at camera; hair away from face and eyes; full head visible

headwear_policy.value: No hat or head covering unless for medical or religious reasons

size.evidence: The nidirect.gov.uk source confirms the photo must be '45 millimetres (mm) high and 35mm wide.' The GOV.UK photo standards page (gov.uk/government/publications/photographic-standards) independently confirms '45mm high x 35mm wide.' Multiple third-party photo services (visafoto, 123passportphoto, makepassportphoto) all list the UK driving licence photo as 35x45mm (width x height). The claimed '45 x 35mm' (height x width ordering) is dimensionally correct.
